module: Development test extension for the gameplay/route/route module: on load, it creates a Route with a small hard-coded 3-point path, then every frame draws the path (spheres, prisms, numbers) via debugDrawer and makes the player vehicle follow it with route:trackVehicle. Loaded with extensions.load('gameplay_rally_test_testRouteFix'). Of no use in normal gameplay.
notes: The path coordinates are fixed (test world); the drawMousePos and drawPath functions exist but their call is commented out in onUpdate.
The file's header comment mentions "extension name: gameplay_rally", which does not match the extension's real name.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: draws the route and calls route:trackVehicle on player vehicle 0 if it exists.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is put back in place; empty body.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: creates the Route and calls setupPathMulti on the test path.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension unloads; empty body.
